title: Weakest Link By Crew Size
description:
## Task

A manager has a line of workers, each with a skill score. A crew is a group of consecutive workers from the line, and a crew is only as good as its weakest member, so its strength is its lowest skill score. For every crew size from 1 up to the whole line, find the best strength achievable by any crew of exactly that size.

## Input

- `skills` — a list of integers. It may be empty.

## Output

A list with one entry per crew size 1..n (n = length of `skills`): entry `s-1` is the highest crew strength among all crews of exactly `s` consecutive workers. An empty line gives an empty list.

## Example

```python
weakest_link_by_crew_size([10, 20, 30, 50, 10, 70])  # returns [70, 30, 20, 10, 10, 10]
weakest_link_by_crew_size([4, 4])  # returns [4, 4]
```

## Constraints

- 0 ≤ length of `skills` ≤ 5 * 10^4
- -10^9 ≤ each score ≤ 10^9
- Computing every crew size by scanning all crews of that size is too slow for the large tests.
